_note: Strings added by the chrome/theme/camera-recovery pass. One file, every language, folded into the base bundles by i18n/index.js — see the comment there for why these live apart from en/hi/or.json. Odia is deliberately absent: an unreviewed Odia draft spoken to someone who cannot read it is worse than honest English in an English voice, and resolve() already handles that fallback. Add `or` here only after a native speaker has checked it.
